subject: [PATCH v8 25/30] mm: handle PMD swap entries in MADV_WILLNEED

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch improves handling of PMD swap entries in MADV_WILLNEED operations by prefetching the whole range as one PMD-order folio instead of walking PTEs individually. This approach avoids issues with order-0 readahead and subsequent faults, and ensures that the eventual fault still takes do_huge_pmd_swap_page(). The patch also checks the THP policy before reading at PMD order to prevent handing do_swap_page() a PMD-sized folio to map with PTEs. If the prefetch fails or if the PMD is split, the patch falls back to the PTE path, which can still read the slots at order 0.
